newsitem.title: CANADA: Pools okayed to vote on United Grain deal.
newsitem.headline: Pools okayed to vote on United Grain deal.

text.p: Canada's competition bureau granted minority United Grain Growers Ltd shareholders Manitoba Pool Elevators and Alberta Wheat Pool the right to vote on Thursday on a deal between UGG and Archer Daniels Midland, an AWP spokesman said on Tuesday.
"The Competition Bureau did indicate we can vote on our shares," AWP spokesman Dale Riddell told Reuters.
AWP and MPE acquired 14.98 percent of UGG shares in February in a failed attempt to acquire the grain handler.
UGG later set a C$113 million deal in which ADM would acquire 45 percent of its limiting common voting shares.
The deal goes to a shareholder vote on Thursday.
AWP's Riddell declined to say how his firm would vote and MPE officials were unavailable for comment.
"We're not commenting on this," UGG Chief Executive Brian Hayward said.
